title: 第1620章 进入冤魂矿洞
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

他们瞄准林风三人脚下的木桩攻击。

大片的范围技能覆盖，三人也阻止不了。

林风沉声说道：【走，加快速度。】

说罢，他自己率先从木桩中间的缝隙一跃而下，直接落在下方的木桩上。

以这样的方式快速朝矿洞深处落去。

剑不凡带着阿四也紧随其后，很快就消失在黑暗中。

后头的人气急败坏。

【追，给我追上他们。】

【哎呀，老大救我。】

渡硬国人还想追。

很快，他们便自食恶果，之前他们打掉的木桩并不会刷新。

不少人直接踏空，从上面掉了下去。

他们又没有林风两人的身手。

后头的人挤上来，像下饺子一样，很快就掉了一半下去。

掉下去的人，还没发出惨叫，便被黑暗中的攻击秒杀。

【混蛋，你们他妈是不是傻逼？】

【你们这群混蛋……自己找死，还要拖累我们，废物。】

他们后方下来的那些渡硬国玩家纷纷将矛头指向他们。

这帮人本来实力就一般。

下去又走不快，后面追上来的人怒气冲冲对他们发动攻击，没一会儿就被全灭。

当然，这对林风来说只是个小插曲。

也多亏这帮二货，让他们脱离大部队。

很快就落到矿洞的底部。

黑暗中，脚踏在地面上。

【下~~下来了？我们真的下来了。】

阿四满脸惊喜。

剑不凡却皱眉说道：【不对啊，从上面看不是还有很深吗？怎么突然就到底了？】

【哈哈，尊敬的大夏国兄弟，这天坑深渊，每次下来都会出现在不同的地方。】

【不同的地方？】

【你可以将它当做一个传送阵，而且是随机的，比如我们下来那一分钟是一起的，就会落到这里，之后一分钟会到另外的地方。】

阿四用蹩脚的话解释了一通。

剑不凡恍然大悟：【你小子还是有点用的，不对啊。。你不是没下来过？为什么知道？】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

They aimed at the wooden stakes at the feet of Lin Feng and the others.

The large area of ​​​​area skills covered, and even three people could not stop it.

Lin Feng said in a deep voice: [Let’s go, speed up.】

After that, he took the lead and jumped down from the gap in the middle of the wooden pile, landing directly on the wooden pile below.

In this way, he quickly fell deep into the mine.

Jian Bufan and Ah Si followed closely behind, and soon disappeared into the darkness.

The people behind were furious.

[Chase, catch up with them.】

[Oh, boss, save me.】

The Dujiu people still want to pursue him.

Soon, they will reap the consequences, as the stakes they knocked down before will not be refreshed.

Many people stepped directly into the air and fell from above.

They don't have the skills of Lin Feng and the other two.

People from behind squeezed in, like dumplings, and soon half of them fell down.

The person who fell was instantly killed by an attack in the darkness before he could even scream.

[Assholes, are you fucking idiots?】

[You bastards... are looking for death on your own, and you want to drag us down, you losers.】

The players from the Hard Kingdom who came down behind them all pointed their fingers at them.

This group of people was originally average in strength.

They couldn't walk fast, and the people who caught up behind them attacked them angrily, and they were all wiped out in a short time.

Of course, this is just a small episode for Lin Feng.

Thanks to these idiots, they were able to escape from the main force.

Soon he fell to the bottom of the mine.

In the darkness, feet hit the ground.

【Getting off~~Coming down?We're really down.】

Ah Si's face was filled with surprise.

Jian Bufan frowned and said, "No, it looks very deep from above, doesn't it?"Why did it come to an end all of a sudden?】

[Haha, dear brothers of Great Xia, this tiankeng abyss will appear in a different place every time you come down.】

【Different places?】

[You can think of it as a teleportation array, and it is random. For example, the minute we come down together, we will fall here, and the next minute we will go to another place.】

Ah Si explained it in bad words.

Jian Bufan suddenly realized: [You are still useful, right?.Haven't you ever been down?Why do you know?】
